title: CLAUDE.md
text: ReliaShiny R package single exported function ReliaShiny() (R/ReliaShiny.R) launches Shiny app via shiny::runApp(). Nearly application logic lives one monolithic file: inst/app/app.R (~1600 lines).

title: CLAUDE.md
text: app uses shinydashboard URL bookmarking enabled. sidebar two main analysis sections: Life Data Analysis — Weibull-based survival analysis using WeibullR package. Users upload select sample time--failure data, choose distribution (Weibull 2P/3P, Lognormal, Weibayes) estimation method (MLE Rank Regression), see probability plots, contour plots, parameter tables. Reliability Growth Analysis — NHPP-based growth modeling using ReliaGrowR package. Users upload select sample cumulative failure data, choose model (Crow-AMSAA, Piecewise NHPP, auto change-point detection), see growth plots, Duane plots, parameter tables.

text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("paulgovan/WeibullR.shiny", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes, commit git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), following prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). title: ReliaShiny v0.5
text: Added Repairable Systems module recurrent event analysis using Non-Homogeneous Poisson Process (NHPP) models (Power Law, Log-Linear). Added Accelerated Life Testing (ALT) module supporting Weibull Lognormal distributions Arrhenius Power Law life-stress relationships. ALT results table now includes goodness--fit metrics life-stress relationship: R², Adj. R², LogLik, AIC, BIC. ALT life-stress relationship plot now displays R² Adj. R² annotation. ALT probability plots include option show/hide confidence bounds. Landing page action buttons now labeled module names sized better usability. Landing page layout responsive: infoboxes buttons stack vertically mobile screens.

title: ReliaShiny v0.5
text: Added comprehensive unit tests summary extraction helper functions (extract_wblr_summ, extract_rga_summ, extract_nhpp_summ, extract_alt_summ). Added end--end shinytest2 tests covering four analysis modules.
